summary.headline: Mars in Gemini, Cancer, and Leo
summary.text: Astrological predictions for Mars entering Gemini, Cancer, and Leo, including war, sedition, disease, earthquakes, weather, crop and water conditions, theft, political unrest, and regional calamities. Tāj al-Dīn Akram is cited on rain, winds, and declining spring and river water.
